competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The closing financial note's 'certain investors affiliated with SBI Holdings' includes affiliates beyond the four entities defined as SBI Stockholders in the selling-securityholder table.
competing_hypotheses.support: The note uses a broader phrase; the table explicitly enumerates four entities and is limited to selling securityholders.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The ownership table and closing note have different measurement dates or include different share categories/registration scopes.
competing_hypotheses.support: The table states beneficial ownership as of October 22 and is limited to shares covered by the prospectus; the note reports securities issued at the October 9 closing.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The figures reflect a filing inconsistency requiring issuer clarification.
competing_hypotheses.support: The disclosed Class A totals differ by 2,316,335 while Class C totals match exactly; the cited sections do not reconcile the difference.

disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: The S-1 states the table is based on information provided by selling securityholders and lists only those persons and securities registered for resale.
The closing note describes 'certain investors affiliated with SBI Holdings', not expressly the four defined SBI Stockholders.
No issuer reconciliation explaining the 2,316,335 Class A difference was found in the reviewed sections.
derived_reconciliation.do_not_infer: The discrepancy does not prove an error, undisclosed purchase, XRP purchase or XRP holding by SBI Holdings.

control_and_voting.control: Each of the four entities is controlled by SBI Holdings, Inc.; the filing says SBI may be deemed to have voting and investment power over their shares, with decisions made by SBI's board by majority vote.
control_and_voting.class_c: Non-voting except limited class-right matters; convertible only subject to the 39.9% ownership cap.
control_and_voting.sbi_holdings_usa_form3: Direct holdings of 6,529,787 Class A and 1,633,180 Class C as of October 9, 2026.
control_and_voting.sbic_separation: SBIC East/Central/West are separate Japanese regional statutory investment companies, not SBI Holdings, Inc. or SBI Holdings USA, Inc.
